method: GLB v2 JSON and binary accessors; actual skin weights/joints, inverse bind counts and varying animation tracks; frozen v0.26.1 registered atlas metadata and byte comparison.
qualifications: Does not establish visual anatomy, texture quality, deformation quality, ground contact or browser performance.
Canonical arm/leg counts are design input prompt assertions, not automated geometry limb detection.
Static environment/weapon/throwable assets do not need a humanoid skin merely to be valid props.
A bind-pose-only clip is not an animated idle; locomotion presence is not attack/hit/death readiness.
Historical/rejected model versions and armature variants are retained; unselected does not mean safe to delete.
